battleTraits.name: IMMORTAL ELITE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HEROES on the battlefield. Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: You gain a number of relentless discipline points equal to the number after the target’s RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent relentless discipline points are lost.

battleTraits.name: REMORSELESS MARCH
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of that unit for the rest of the phase. That unit cannot use RUN abilities for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: IMPASSIVE RETREAT
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. For the rest of the turn, that unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: RUTHLESS EXTERMINATION
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for a unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase
battleTraits.effect:
Used By: The unit using that SHOOT ability.
Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that SHOOT ability.

battleTraits.name: PITILESS ASSAULT
battleTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase
battleTraits.effect:
Used By: The unit using that FIGHT ability.
Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made as part of that FIGHT ability.

battleTraits.name: INVIOLATE LEGIONS
battleTraits.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
battleTraits.effect:
Used By: A friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit targeted by that ATTACK ability. Friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units can use this ability more than once per phase.
Spend 1 relentless discipline point. That unit has WARD (5+) against damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability.

battleTraits.name: ETHEREAL
battleTraits.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH NIGHTHAUNT units, excluding Nagash.

battleTraits.name: LEGIONS OF ENDLESS DEAD
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with 2 or more friendly units if any of those friendly units is Nagash or if none of those friendly units share any of the following keywords: SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS, FLESH-EATER COURTS, NIGHTHAUNT or OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS.

battleTraits.name: CONSTRUCTS OF PETRIFIED BONE
battleTraits.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly PETRIFEX ELITE unit in each phase.

battleTraits.name: RELENTLESS ONSLAUGHT
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO INFANTRY unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of models in the target unit, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) in friendly territory, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: SHATTERING STRIKE
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly PETRIFEX ELITE unit that charged this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: CEASELESS ADVANCE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly PETRIFEX ELITE unit that is in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by RETREAT abilities, but when the target uses a RETREAT ability, it must end the move closer to or in enemy territory.

battleTraits.name: PRAETORIAN ELITE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly LANCE OF OSSIA HEROES on the battlefield. Pick a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA HERO to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: You gain a number of relentless discipline points equal to the number shown after the target’s RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent relentless discipline points are lost.

battleTraits.name: VENGEFUL OUTRIDERS
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Add 2" to that unit’s Move characteristic for the rest of the phase.

battleTraits.name: KAVALOS LANCE
battleTraits.effect: When a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA unit uses the ‘Power Through’ command, the target does not have to have a lower Health characteristic than that friendly unit.

battleTraits.name: SILENT MENACE
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. The target cannot use the ‘Redeploy’ command for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: FURY OF ZANDTOS
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA unit that charged this turn and that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. That unit’s melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: BLOOD-SMEARED HOOVES
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA unit that charged this turn and has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s weapons, including Companion weapons, for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: ARCANE IMMUNITY
battleTraits.effect: Friendly NULL MYRIAD units have WARD (4+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

battleTraits.name: SUPERNATURAL ABSORPTION
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy MANIFESTATION within a friendly NULL MYRIAD unit’s combat range to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• The target is banished and removed from play.
• If that friendly unit is damaged, Heal (X) that friendly unit, where X is the target’s Health characteristic.
• If that friendly unit is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to X, where X is the target’s Health characteristic.

battleTraits.name: FIRST OF THE MORTARCHS
battleTraits.effect:
Each time you make a casting roll for a friendly Arkhan the Black, if all the following are true, that spell cannot be unbound:
• The unmodified casting roll contains 2 or more results of the same value.
• The casting roll equals or exceeds the spell’s casting value.
• The spell is not miscast.

abilities.name: GRIM SENTINELS
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.

abilities.name: NADIRITE WEDGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit’s melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SILENT EMPIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1 while it is within neutral territory or your territory.

abilities.name: UNFALTERING PACE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability for a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using RUN ability
If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: PLENTIFUL BONE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to use this ability, then pick up to 3 visible friendly non-FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units wholly within 12" of that WIZARD to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is damaged, Heal (X) the target where X is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic equal to or less than the roll.

abilities.name: DISCIPLINED HEKATOI
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO non-FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
• The target has WARD (5+).
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks.
• The target’s melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend).

entries.name: EMPOWER NADIRITE WEAPONS
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
The target’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) until the start of your next turn. If all of the target’s non-Companion melee weapons had Crit (2 Hits) when they were picked to be the target of this ability, the target’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead.
Friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units can be affected by this ability multiple times.

entries.name: IMMOLATING FLAMES
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: DRAIN VITALITY
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks and subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.

entries.name: BOLSTER CREATION
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase.

entries.name: INVIGORATE THE RANKS
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: SOUL-CLAIM
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of that WIZARD to be a friendly target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy target. If any models are slain by this ability, pick 1 of the following:
• Heal (3) the friendly target.
• Return a number of slain models to the friendly target with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

entries.name: SUMMON NIGHTMARE PREDATOR
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Nightmare Predator on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Nightmare Predator wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: SUMMON BONE-TITHE SHRIEKER
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Bone-tithe Shrieker on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Bone-tithe Shrieker wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: SUMMON SOULSTEALER CARRION
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulstealer Carrion on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Soulstealer Carrion wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Arch-Kavalos Zandtos

abilityDetails.name: Unstoppable Charge
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.
Effect: The targets have STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Still Their Breath!
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS CAVALRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If this unit is in combat, no relentless discipline points are spent. The target’s melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) for the rest of the turn.

melee: Kavalos Steed’s Hooves, Teeth and Barbed Tails

entries.flavour: Known and feared as the Dark Lance of Ossia, Zandtos has a burning hatred for the living that Nagash has stoked to the point of obsession. Those with the temerity to invade Shyish bear the full brunt of his undying wrath.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Legion Subcommander.

entries.name: Arkhan the Black, Mortarch of Sacrament

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Razarak’s Ebon Claws is 3.

abilityDetails.name: The Staff of Spirits
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. Each time this unit successfully casts a spell, Heal (1) this unit after that SPELL ability has been resolved.

abilityDetails.name: The Doom of Traitors
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a WIZARD or PRIEST. On a 2+, add an amount equal to the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Razarak’s Ebon Claws for the rest of the phase, but while this unit is in combat with the target, all attacks made with that weapon this phase must target that enemy unit.
Designer’s Note: If the target is a WIZARD or PRIEST, this ability cannot fail; however, you still need to roll to determine the number of extra attacks it generates.

abilityDetails.name: Mortarch of Sacrament
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a unit within 18" of this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound, its effect is not resolved and that SPELL ability cannot be used by enemy units until the start of your next turn.

abilityDetails.name: Curse of Years
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 6:
• Give the target 1 necrotic withering point.
• Roll an extra dice.
For each 5+ on those extra dice, repeat the above bullet points, Then, do the same for each 4+ and then each 3+. Finally, for each 2+, give the target 1 necrotic withering point (do not roll any extra dice).
After a roll, if the target has 8 or more necrotic withering points, it is automatically destroyed. Otherwise, after the last roll, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of necrotic withering points it has. Then, those necrotic withering points are lost.

entries.flavour: Arkhan is a master of necromantic magic and the most trusted servant of Nagash. Roiling clouds of deathly magic swirl about the skeletal form of the Mortarch of Sacrament as he rides to war upon his dread abyssal Razarak.

entries.name: Bone-tithe Nexus

abilityDetails.name: Deadly Aura
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Enemy units cannot be set up within X" of this terrain feature, where X is determined by the current battle round, as follows:
$000002415

entries.flavour: The Ossiarch tithemasters often demand their grisly bounty be left at designated nexuses of power, the soul energy and raw bone of these sites evoking a repellent aura of death. Should any transgressors attempt to interfere with the Bone-tithe Nexus, the statue at its heart will unleash its deadly blade.
entries.description:
The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):
Cover, Unstable

entries.name: Bone-tithe Shrieker

abilityDetails.name: No Escape
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this MANIFESTATION.

entries.flavour: The Bone-tithe Shrieker is a four-headed, all-seeing monstrosity conjured to hunt down those who would escape the Ossiarch tithe. When it locates its quarry, it will give vent to an awful, mind-chilling scream that dulls the wits and shivers the bones of those living creatures nearby, making them easy prey for the Ossiarchs themselves.

entries.name: Gothizzar Harvester

abilityDetails.name: Bone Cage
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit is either full or empty. It starts the battle full.

abilityDetails.name: Bone Harvest
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit that has been destroyed this battle. Add 1 to each roll if this unit used a FIGHT ability this turn. If any of the rolls are a 4+, this unit is full.

abilityDetails.name: Repair Construct
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is full, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target has a Health characteristic of 1 return 3 slain models to it instead. Then, this unit is empty.

entries.flavour: The Gothizzar Harvester collects the remains of the slain, stripping them of flesh and storing them in a gaping cage of bone on its back. It bludgeons and cleaves those in reach of its primary arms even as its secondary limbs gather the dead.

entries.name: Immortis Guard

abilityDetails.name: Immortal Bulwark
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
Effect: Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Towering over the rank-and-file Bonereapers, the Immortis Guard form a tough physical bulwark around the leaders of the Ossiarch cohorts. Those who come too close are hurled back by shields then swiftly impaled on spiked halberds.

entries.name: Kainan’s Reapers

abilityDetails.name: Nadirite Bow
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit’s Nohem is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilityDetails.name: Mir Kainan
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit’s Mir Kainan is on the battlefield, this unit has WIZARD (1), Relentless Discipline (2) and can be picked as the target of the ‘Immortal Elite’ ability as if it had the HERO keyword.

entries.flavour: Mir Kainan is a brutal enforcer of the Mortisans, fanatically devoted to ensuring the bone-tithe is met. Certainly, any confronted by this osseous goliath soon dredge up outstanding ‘payments’ – better that than face the annihilating swing of Kainan’s axe. The Reapers serve as Mir Kainan’s heralds, a cadre of elite Mortek Guard who back up the enforcer’s demands with clinical violence. Wielding the finest nadirite wargear, they cut down their opponents without hesitation or remorse – exemplars of the Bonereapers’ dark efficiency.
entries.description:
The models in this unit are:
• Mir Kainan (armed with a Soulreaper Axe)
• Binar Khenta (armed with a Nadirite Weapon)
• Karu (armed with a Nadirite Weapon)
• Senha (armed with a Nadirite Weapon)
• Hakor (armed with a Nadirite Weapon)
• Nohem (armed with a Nadirite Weapon)

entries.name: Katakros, Mortarch of the Necropolis

abilities: Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the number after its RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE keyword is 4.

abilityDetails.name: Mortarch of the Necropolis
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units that have used any RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE abilities this turn.

abilityDetails.name: Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit that is in combat and has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to be the target.
Effect: Spend a number of relentless discipline points equal to the target’s Health characteristic. The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn. In addition, the target cannot use RE

abilityDetails.name: You Dare?!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if at least half of the units from your starting army have been destroyed.
Effect: For the rest of the battle round:
• Add 5 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Inda-Khaat.
• Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s The Shield Immortis.
• This unit cannot use the ’Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions’ ability.

abilityDetails.name: Aviarch Spymaster
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Orpheon Katakros is an immortal demigod of war. A military genius, he is a consummate commander; in conjunction with his trusted retainers, he bolsters the Ossiarch legions with iron resolve, surging physical power and uncanny insight.

entries.name: Kavalos Deathriders

abilityDetails.name: Deathrider Wedge
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly Liege-Kavalos within this unit’s combat range to be the friendly target.
Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy target. Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the enemy target if you picked a friendly target. Then, this unit and the friendly target (if any) can move 10". They can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

entries.flavour: The heavy cavalry of the Bonereaper legions, the Kavalos Deathriders are expert riders mounted on macabre armoured steeds. They clatter into the foe in a wedge formation, breaking battlelines with every ferocious charge.

entries.name: Kavalos War Chariot

abilityDetails.name: Scything Assault
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.

abilityDetails.name: Pinning Attacks
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Liege-Kavalos on War Chariot, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The Kavalos War Chariot is a devastating weapon in the arsenal of the Ossiarch Bonereapers. Pulled by a pair of osseous steed-constructs, the charioteers either smash their way through enemy formations or else harry foes from a distance with loosed arrows and hurled javelins.

entries.name: Liege-Kavalos

abilityDetails.name: Master of Cavalry
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly Kavalos Deathriders unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Deathrider Commander
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit and visible friendly Kavalos Deathriders units wholly within 12" of this unit can move 12" instead of 10" when they use the ‘Deathrider Wedge’ ability.

melee: Kavalos Steed’s Hooves, Teeth and Barbed Tails

entries.flavour: A Liege-Kavalos is a cavalry commander of uncanny skill and resilience. With a harsh order, they can drive their Bonereapers to redouble their attack, hacking into the enemy ranks even as they fell dangerous foes with their commander's blade.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Legion Subcommander.

entries.name: Liege-Kavalos on War Chariot

abilityDetails.name: Grind Them to Dust
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly Kavalos War Chariots wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat to be the targets.
Effect: For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilityDetails.name: Masterful Charioteer
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is in combat and has charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly Kavalos War Chariots that have charged this turn, that are wholly within 12" of this unit and that are in combat to be the targets.
Effect: Each target has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: A Liege-Kavalos atop a War Chariot leads their fellow charioteers into battle, guiding them in defensive manoeuvres that allow them to skilfully evade the foe. Keen is their knowledge of this kind of warfare, and their command of these war engines is absolute.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Legion Subcommander.

entries.name: Liege-Mortek

abilityDetails.name: Clinical Efficiency
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase, Reaction: You declared a %000010870Fight ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Pick a visible friendly Mortek Guard, Mortek Triaxes or Mortek Crawler unit that has not used an ATTACK ability this phase and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use either a SHOOT ability as if it were your shooting phase or a FIGHT ability. If it is picked to do so:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
• The target’s ranged weapons (if any) have Shoot in Combat

entries.flavour: The infantry field officers of the Ossiarch legions, Liege-Morteks often fight among Mortek troops, improving their efficiency and cohesion in battle. With but a gesture, they can unleash devastating assaults that send their foes reeling.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Legion Subcommander.

entries.name: Morghast Archai

abilityDetails.name: Ebon-wrought Armour
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has WARD (3+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

abilityDetails.name: Discharge Armour
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The Morghast Archai were crafted by Nagash himself to act as both personal guard and executioners. They soar into battle like omens of death, ignoring the feeble strikes and missiles that deflect off their soul-forged armour.

entries.name: Morghast Harbingers

abilityDetails.name: Harbingers of Death
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

entries.flavour: Morghast Harbingers are used as swift-striking shock troops in the Ossiarch legions, darting in with terrifying speed for such monstrous creatures. They descend from the skies like macabre angels then butcher the foe with their darksome blades.

entries.name: Mortek Crawler

abilityDetails.name: Deathly Barrage
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: After that SHOOT ability has been resolved, if all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Mortisan Ossifector, and add 1 to the roll if any other friendly Mortek Crawlers picked that enemy unit to be the target of all of their shooting attacks this turn. On a 4+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Cursed Stele
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• This unit’s ranged weapons have Anti-FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend).
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for attacks that target faction terrain features.

entries.flavour: An unliving artillery piece that moves with centipedal ripples as it creeps towards the perfect vantage point, the Mortek Crawler is a dread catapult that can fire a variety of unnatural ammunition types, each imbued with fiendish concentrations of deathly energy.

entries.name: Mortek Guard

abilityDetails.name: Shields of the Legion
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted a %000010532visible% OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit within this unit’s %000009665combat range%
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that Attack ability that target any friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units within this unit’s combat range.

entries.flavour: The Mortek Guard are soul-constructs created to dominate the battlefield. Disciplined, dispassionate and armed with life-draining nadirite weapons, they grind the enemy to dust beneath their relentless march.

entries.name: Mortek Triaxes

abilityDetails.name: Balefire Braziers
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit’s Balefire Braziers are tokens. There are 2 Balefire Braziers for every 10 models in this unit. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its Balefire Braziers next to it.

abilityDetails.name: Cursed Flames
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: After that SHOOT ability has been resolved, if all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and this unit has any Balefire Braziers next to it, place 1 of those Balefire Braziers next to that enemy unit.

abilityDetails.name: Atavistic Nightmares
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: While any of this unit’s Balefire Braziers are next to an enemy unit, subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units within that enemy unit’s combat range.
If an ability would heal or return slain models to an enemy unit while any of this unit’s Balefire Braziers are next to it, that ability does not heal or return any slain models to it. Instead, place those Balefire Braziers next to this unit.

entries.flavour: Unleashing death from afar, Mortek Triaxes rain down volleys of nadirite shafts upon their foes. These triple-eyed archers wreathe their arrowheads in flaming soul-essence, invoking unnatural horror in their victims.

entries.name: Mortis Reapers

abilityDetails.name: Necrocaches
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this unit can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

abilityDetails.name: No Escaping the Tithe
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If there are no enemy units within 6" of this unit, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: Dread assassins of forbidding aspect, Mortis Reapers slip behind enemy lines to target vulnerable leaders. Enshrouded in a shimmering heat haze and bearing deadly necrocaches, none can escape the dreaded bone-tithe they are sent to collect.

entries.name: Mortisan Boneshaper

abilityDetails.name: Boneshaper
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly Mortek Guard or Mortek Triaxes unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat.

abilityDetails.name: Legion Quartermaster
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time a friendly non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

entries.flavour: The Boneshaper's art is that of creation, not destruction. Though their ossified talons can rake through flesh, they focus their efforts on regenerating the Ossiarch regiments around them, creating new constructs from shattered remains.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Mortisan Vizier.

entries.name: Mortisan Ossifector

abilityDetails.name: Refined Creations
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly Mortek Crawler, Gothizzar Harvester, Morghast Archai or Morghast Harbingers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

entries.flavour: Mortisan Ossifectors are dedicated to fashioning the greatest warriors of the Bonereaper hosts. Even in the midst of battle, they can be found developing their craft to enhance their lethal potential.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Mortisan Vizier.

entries.name: Mortisan Soulmason

abilityDetails.name: Soul-guide
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: The target has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Captive souls are fodder for the most gifted of the Mortisan spirit-crafters. Borne to war upon thrones of bodily remains with their own vicious animus, the Soulmasons focus the animating energies of necromancy into their Bonereaper creations.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Mortisan Vizier.

entries.name: Mortisan Soulreaper

abilityDetails.name: Soulreaper
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Necrotic Blast
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. After this ability has been resolved, you gain a number of relentless discipline points equal to the number of total damage points allocated by this ability this turn.

entries.flavour: The Soulreapers are the more destructive members of the Mortisan order. It is their role to cut the souls from the enemy with their magical scythes, using the harvested spirits to sap their enemies' strength or fuel a burst of deathly energy.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Mortisan Vizier.

entries.name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilityDetails.name: The Staff of Power
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

abilityDetails.name: Hand of Dust
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy HERO or MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

abilityDetails.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly DEATH unit, pick 1 of the following effects:
• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilityDetails.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO non-UNIQUE DEATH unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: All living beings dread the name of Nagash, the God of Undeath. Cruel and tyrannical, the overlord of Shyish intends to conquer the Mortal Realms and transform them into a lifeless Necrotopia, in which not a speck of dust moves unless it is by his will.

entries.name: Necropolis Stalkers

abilityDetails.name: Fourfold Slayers
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If this unit has 3 or more models, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+ instead.

entries.flavour: Four-armed horrors that possess ferocious killing prowess, Necropolis Stalkers leap and spin into battle with terrifying speed, laying waste to hordes of foes in the blink of an eye.

entries.name: Nightmare Predator

abilityDetails.name: Death Incarnate
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this MANIFESTATION was destroyed or banished this turn and the unit that summoned it is on the battlefield, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any enemy models were slain by this MANIFESTATION’s combat attacks this turn. On a 4+, set up this MANIFESTATION again, wholly within 12" of the unit that summoned it and more than 9" from all enemy units. That unit has summoned that MANIFESTATION.

entries.flavour: The Nightmare Predator is a looming conjuration of Shyishan magic that takes the form of a disturbing terror. It floats eerily through the air towards its master's chosen prey, lacerating the flesh of its screaming victims with claws the size of sickles before stripping them to the bone.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Mortis Reapers

abilityDetails.name: Terminate Their Command
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible enemy HERO within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: If the target is more than 3" from all other enemy units, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.

abilityDetails.name: The Coldness of Death
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If an enemy Hero was destroyed by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, your opponent must reduce their fury level to 0.

entries.flavour: Enshrouded by a shimmering heat haze that is only enhanced by the scorching Aqshian climate, the stealthy Mortis Reapers slip between enemy lines, seeking out leaders and champions marked for assassination.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Vokmortian, Master of the Bone-tithe

abilityDetails.name: Master of the Bone-Tithe
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Your opponent must pick 1 of the following effects:
Pay the Tithe: Your opponent must pick a unit in their army on the battlefield to be the target. They cannot pick a MANIFESTATION or terrain feature. Then:
• Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.
• Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot be healed, have slain models returned to it or be replaced.
Deny the Ossiarchs their Rightful Due: Pick 1 of the following effects:
• You gain 4 relentless discipline points.
• Pick an objective you do not control. For the re

abilityDetails.name: Cowed into Inaction
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy HERO within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time an enemy unit within the target’s combat range uses a command, unless your opponent spends 1 rage dice to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are lost.

entries.flavour: As High Emissarian, it is Vokmortian’s duty to ensure that ample bone is harvested in order to replenish the Ossiarch legions as they battle across the Realm of Fire. This he achieves through terrifying oratory, dark magic and ruthless precision.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Mortek Guard

abilityDetails.name: Shields of the Legion
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: A friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS %000016215WAR MACHINE% or %000005667WIZARD% within this unit’s combat range was targeted by an ATTACK ability.
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit.

entries.flavour: The backbone of the Ossiarch legions are the Mortek Guard, undead imbued with martial skill blended from the spiritual essence of slain warriors and armed with soul-draining nadirite weapons. They are as proficient on the open field as they are when defending against a Ghyranite ambush. Whenever the great war-constructs and commanders of the Bonereapers are threatened, these unflinching warriors will close ranks and surround their ward with an impenetrable shieldwall.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Mortisan Boneshaper

abilityDetails.name: Legion Quartermaster
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time a friendly non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilityDetails.name: Boneshaper
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly Mortek Guard unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: Masters of necro-crafting techniques, Mortisan Boneshapers weave osseous matter into new war-constructs and use it to repair damage inflicted upon their Mortek warriors. Without the Boneshapers, the Ossiarchs’ attritional wars in the Jade Kingdoms would have long since faltered. The greatest of their number can cause entire shattered regiments of Ossiarch infantry to rise again, ready to renew their grinding war against the living.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Soulstealer Carrion

abilityDetails.name: Aviarch Sentry
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this MANIFESTATION.

entries.flavour: The Soulstealer Carrion is a soul-linked construct that soars from its caster's spread fingertips to take wing above the battlefield. Its caster can see through the avian conjuration's eyes; when it perceives spiritual energy unclaimed, it will swoop down to capture it.

entries.name: Teratic Cohort

abilityDetails.name: Beast
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilityDetails.name: Hunters Unleashed
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilityDetails.name: Bone-deep Savagery
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can move 3". If it can move into combat, it must. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

entries.flavour: The Ossiarch constructs of the Teratic Cohort are a grim example of those who have failed in their duty to Nagash. Nonetheless, their bestial forms make them lethally adept as hunters and the impure methods of their physical refashioning have rendered them savage in combat.

entries.name: Thanatek’s Tithe

abilityDetails.name: Seeker of Truebone
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This unit can be picked to be the target of the ‘Immortal Elite’ ability as if it had the HERO keyword.
Each time a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit is destroyed, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit gains 1 portion of truebone. Each time a visible friendly non-BEAST OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit is destroyed, this unit gains 1 portion of truebone.

abilityDetails.name: Truebone Mastery
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Spend any number of this unit’s portions of truebone. For each portion spent, pick 1 of the effects below. Each effect can be picked multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
• Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.
• Add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.
• Gain 1 relentless discipline point.
• Return 1 slain model to this unit

entries.flavour: The Ossiarch agent Thanatek seeks to gather ‘truebone’ – osseous matter of unusual purity. To aid him, the Emissarian has created a group of warriors he believes ideally suited to the task. The assassins Tukhar and Sekhmor slay his targets cleanly, whilst the Mornial-caste retainers known as Xar-Tamok and Medeb-Ahk gather the remains in ensorcelled caskets that are conjoined to their bodies

entries.name: The Grand Necromystic

abilityDetails.name: Battlefield Enhancements
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If an enemy HERO or MONSTER was destroyed by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons to be the target weapon.
Effect: Roll a D3. Add the result to the Attacks characteristic of the target weapon for the rest of the battle.

abilityDetails.name: Crushing Bonebulk
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy non-MONSTER unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll 2D6. Then, your opponent must roll a dice. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the two rolls.
This unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The Grand Necromystic is the head of the Necrosian Cabal and the de facto ruler of the Petrifex Elite. It is said that no one has ever seen the Grand Necromystic’s true form, and there are rumours that he may not have one at all, preferring to inhabit the form of one of his many bone constructs.

entries.name: Vokmortian, Master of the Bone-tithe

abilityDetails.name: Voice of Nagash
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: The target cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any non-CORE abilities used by other enemy units for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Mortal Contract
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use a CORE ability, roll a D3 as a reaction. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that CORE ability.

entries.flavour: It is Vokmortian's task to oversee the harvesting of bones for the Ossiarch legions, a duty he undertakes with ruthless, calculating precision. Those who think to defy the will of the Great Necromancer are reminded of the folly of this course by the severed, wailing heads hanging from Vokmortian's staff.
